(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA)
After addressing the arguments for considerable length of time, learned counsel for the petitioner files a memo.

The said memo reads as under:
"Memo for withdrawal May if your lordship.

That the counsel for the petitioner submits as under:
That the petitioner is not intend to press with the petition.
Hence, the petitioner may kindly be permitted to withdraw the petition as not pressed.
Kindly liberty to file a fresh petition.
Hence, this memo."
NC: 2025:KHC-K:2872 HC-KAR Placing the aforesaid memo on record, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.

Sd/-
(V SRISHANANDA) JUDGE SVH CT:PK Pandurang vs The State Of Karnataka on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30295970/
